outcome.observed_limitation: At the implementation base, ECI attached verification detail to failed verification owner results, so a completed owner pass with unsupported obligations exposed aggregate counts without the exact unsupported obligation and reason context in service-accountability.
outcome.interpretation: This is an evidence-discoverability limitation in the Environment projection. The recorded executor and suite reasons do not establish that Environment caused the underlying unsupported obligations.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Completed ambient verification can hide exact unsupported obligation causes
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment ECI verification owner-result projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The current immutable verification record is integrity-addressed and reports eight unsupported obligations, including seven executor-not-native and one suite-undeclared. The pre-change ECI path only attached detailed verification evidence when the owner result reported failure, leaving a completed but incomplete verification outcome without those causes in the service-accountability summary.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose bounded exact verification coverage and unsupported-obligation causes through the existing ECI service-accountability projection, retaining source-integrity and omission status and leaving overall verification unestablished when coverage is incomplete.
